reason: A dsh web text-to-speech plugin that reads final assistant replies and approval prompts aloud using Edge TTS or browser speech synthesis, with configurable voices, playback controls, and notification sounds.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh web 将助手最终答复和审批提示转换为语音播放，并提供音色、语速、自动朗读及提示音设置。
summaries.en: A dsh web text-to-speech plugin that reads final assistant replies and approval prompts aloud with configurable voices, speed, autoplay, and notification sounds.

capabilities: Reads final assistant replies from the current dsh web session for speech playback
Requests speech synthesis from Microsoft Edge TTS over the network
Runs a localhost HTTP bridge for speech synthesis requests
Plays generated audio in the browser and can fall back to browser speech synthesis
Stores plugin settings in browser localStorage
Reads approval prompts and plays configurable notification sounds
